cards.caption_en: Rain outside, a quiet store, and my umbrella by the door.
cards.caption_zh: 门外下着雨，店里很安静，我的雨伞就在门边。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated ivory and slate clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores with subtle magazine retouch, real hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable, calm blank space near image borders for later annotations. No text, letters, digits, logos, brand names, watermark or UI. Fashion rainwear boutique, medium-wide environmental portrait. Woman just inside open glass door at left holding ONE clear transparent umbrella tilted beside her, face visible. Rain visible outside door as fine streaks and wet pavement, cool overcast light. Interior rainwear display at right: neatly spaced black raincoat, white raincoat, grey raincoat, brown rain boots, and one distinctly BLUE rain jacket. All five colors readable, no hybrid colors. Boutique shelving and simple clothing rail establish store, no signage or written prices. Clear umbrella handle, authentic water drops and fabric, generous calm top wall.

words.example: I hold an umbrella by the door.
words.translation: 我在门边拿着一把雨伞。
words.evidence: 透明雨伞整体，不含主人公

words.example: The rain falls outside the store.
words.evidence: 左侧玻璃门外的雨滴与湿地面区域，rain指向可见降雨线索；天气由原创场景确认。

words.example: I enter the store.
words.evidence: 右侧衣架与雨具货品的商店局部区域，store由原创购物设定说明；未框整栋建筑。

words.example: The raincoat on the rack is black.
words.evidence: 可见雨具中与例句对应的黑色雨衣，颜色词定位这件物品的实际区域。

words.example: One raincoat is white.
words.evidence: 可见雨具中与例句对应的白色雨衣，颜色词定位这件物品的实际区域。

words.example: The grey raincoat is beside the white one.
words.translation: 灰色雨衣在白色雨衣旁边。
words.evidence: 可见雨具中与例句对应的灰色雨衣，颜色词定位这件物品的实际区域。

words.example: The boots are brown.
words.evidence: 可见雨具中与例句对应的棕色靴子，颜色词定位这件物品的实际区域。

words.example: The jacket is blue.
words.evidence: 可见雨具中与例句对应的蓝色夹克，颜色词定位这件物品的实际区域。

cards.caption_en: I get fresh vegetables at the market and carry them home.
cards.caption_zh: 我在市场买新鲜蔬菜，再把它们带回家。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated ivory and slate clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores with subtle magazine retouch, real hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable, calm blank space near image borders for later annotations. No text, letters, digits, logos, brand names, watermark or UI. Elegant covered outdoor vegetable market, adult woman arranging green vegetables in one wicker shopping BASKET on wooden stall front-left. A distinct small wire shopping CART with two wheels and handle stands at front-right, not a second basket. Small shallow tray with a few metal COINS on counter center-front, distinct from vegetables. One blank upright price card beside vegetables, absolutely no letters or numbers. Produce stalls behind establish market, no crowd, realistic cool daylight, crisp basket weave, coherent hands, calm negative space top and bottom.

words.example: I buy vegetables at the market.
words.evidence: 左侧陈列蔬菜的市场摊位区域，market的经营场景由原创设定说明；不框整张照片。

words.example: The basket holds vegetables.
words.evidence: 装蔬菜的独立藤编购物篮

words.example: The cart has wheels.
words.evidence: 右侧金属购物手推车，区别藤篮

words.example: The price of the vegetables is low.
words.evidence: 价格由原创例句说明，空白价牌不能当已读价格

words.example: These vegetables are cheap today.
words.evidence: 便宜是原创情境中的价格评价，不由外观推断

words.example: I pay money for the vegetables.
words.evidence: 浅托盘中的金属硬币，钱的用途由交易故事明确

words.example: I get fresh vegetables at the market.
words.translation: 我在市场买到新鲜蔬菜。
words.evidence: get采用获得/买到义，由购物句子明确

cards.caption_en: I keep the receipt as a record of my payment.
cards.caption_zh: 我留好收据，作为这次付款的记录。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated ivory and slate clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores with subtle magazine retouch, real hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable, calm blank space near image borders for later annotations. No text, letters, digits, logos, brand names, watermark or UI. Refined small independent homewares shop checkout. Young adult female customer at left in ivory blouse receiving ONE narrow blank receipt strip from another adult woman shop owner at right in slate blouse. Both faces visible, natural coherent hands. Counter shows compact unbranded register, open ledger with faint unrecognizable ruled lines but no readable marks, small tray with a few metal coins. Neutral ceramic wares shelf behind establishes small shop. Receipt clearly separate from ledger, no card terminal logos or numbers, cool window daylight, calm wall top and clear counter bottom.

words.example: I make a payment for the cup.
words.evidence: 付款是原创交易设定，不声称照片证实支付成功

words.example: I keep the receipt.
words.evidence: 两人之间独立纸条，收据身份由原创交易设定明确；不声称纸上金额可读

words.example: The owner keeps an account of each sale.
words.translation: 店主记录每笔销售的账目。
words.evidence: 柜台右侧展开的账本区域；account的账目义由原创句子说明，定位承载账目的账本，不虚构可读金额。

words.example: In this story, the shop lets me buy on credit.
words.translation: 在这个故事里，商店允许我赊购。
words.evidence: 补充虚构交易例句，不把当场付款和赊购混为同一事实

words.example: I pay the debt I owe to the shop.
words.evidence: 债务由原创句子说明，不从钱币或表情认定

words.example: The owner runs a small business.
words.evidence: 经营关系由原创设定说明

words.example: The shop makes a profit when sales exceed costs.
words.translation: 销售收入超过成本时，商店就有利润。
words.evidence: 利润概念以条件句说明，不虚构照片中的金额或收益

words.example: The owner gives me a receipt.
words.evidence: 右侧递出收据的女性为原创故事店主，框定位该角色；所有权由故事设定说明，不凭服装推定。

cards.caption_en: A silver ring makes this quiet moment feel special.
cards.caption_zh: 一枚银戒指，让这个安静的时刻变得特别。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated ivory and slate clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores with subtle magazine retouch, real hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable, calm blank space near image borders for later annotations. No text, letters, digits, logos, brand names, watermark or UI. Refined jewelry gift table editorial. Adult woman at rear center gently arranging a velvet gift box. Foreground clearly separated teaching props: ONE plain SILVER RING standing in an open slate velvet ring box at left-front; one loose large faceted BLUE GEMSTONE on tiny dark velvet pad center-front; a simple GOLD BRACELET on white dish right-front; small decorative CERAMIC STAR ornament on left-mid table; blank cream folded GREETING CARD standing right-mid table; one short ivory WAX CANDLE unlit in clear holder rear-right. Crisp gemstone facets, authentic metallic reflections and wax surface, restrained luxury, no text on card, no logos, quiet negative space.

words.example: The ring is in the box.
words.evidence: 左前方盒中的独立戒指

words.example: The blue jewel is on the velvet.
words.evidence: 独立有切面的蓝色宝石，身份由原创设定说明，不声称已鉴定天然产地

words.example: In this story, the bracelet is made of gold.
words.translation: 在这个故事里，手镯是金制的。
words.evidence: 前景右侧金色手镯的实际区域；金材质由原创故事明确，框定位所指手镯，不从反光鉴定黄金。

words.example: In this story, the ring is made of silver.
words.translation: 在这个故事里，戒指是银制的。
words.evidence: 前景戒指的实际区域；银材质来自原创故事，框定位所指戒指，不从颜色鉴定银。

words.example: The star is an ornament.
words.evidence: 桌上独立陶瓷星形装饰品

words.example: The card stands beside the gift.
words.evidence: 右侧独立折叠贺卡，不是收据；用途由原创设定说明

words.example: The ring is a special gift for me.
words.translation: 这枚戒指是给我的特别礼物。
words.evidence: 特别这一情感评价由原创叙述说明

words.example: The candle is made of wax.
words.evidence: 右侧蜡烛蜡质柱体区域；蜡材质由原创设定说明，不把烛台玻璃等同于蜡。

cards.caption_en: I exchange the broken cup for a new one.
cards.caption_zh: 我把坏掉的杯子换成一只新的。
cards.image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated ivory and slate clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores with subtle magazine retouch, real hands and materials. Cool soft daylight, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable, calm blank space near image borders for later annotations. No text, letters, digits, logos, brand names, watermark or UI. Refined homewares shop returns counter. Adult young female customer at left wearing ivory blouse, another adult female shop assistant at right in slate blouse comparing TWO matching white ceramic cups only. LEFT cup new and pristine, complete curved handle, clean glossy surface. RIGHT cup older with one clear chipped rim and broken handle; a separate small handle fragment lies beside it on counter, realistic break not melting. Cups large in clear foreground, hands lightly gesturing behind cups, no fingers inside shards, two faces visible. Original calm exchange interaction, neutral shop shelf background, generous quiet top wall and bottom counter, no printed tags.

words.example: The cup on the left is new.
words.evidence: 左侧完整杯子的实际区域；new身份由原创退换货故事明确，框只定位新杯，不以清洁程度推断新旧。

words.example: The cup on the right is old.
words.evidence: 右侧破损旧杯和断柄碎片区域；old身份由原创故事明确，不由破损程度推断使用年限。

words.example: The old cup has a broken handle.
words.evidence: 右杯缺损的口沿、断柄及桌上断柄碎片区域，broken对应这些直接可见破损。

words.example: I check the quality of the new cup.
words.evidence: 质量是检查与判断，由叙述说明

words.example: The new cup is good value for the money.
words.evidence: 采用物有所值搭配，主观评价由例句明确，不推算真实价格

words.example: I make a comparison of the two cups.
words.evidence: 前景两只同类杯子的对照区域，comparison指向实际比较对象，不包含全幅人物背景。

words.example: I exchange the broken cup for a new one.
words.translation: 我把坏掉的杯子换成一只新的。
words.evidence: 采用动词换货，由原创对话叙述明确，不从递物动作认定已完成业务

words.example: I change my choice after checking the cups.
words.translation: 检查杯子后，我改变了选择。
words.evidence: 改变采用决定变化义，与exchange换货区分

words.example: One cup is new; the other cup is old.
words.translation: 一只杯子是新的，另一只杯子是旧的。
words.evidence: 限定词other修饰cup，两件物品与句子支持

lexical_review.method: Codex按本卡语境独立编辑复核，不声称已访问词典全文。
